N-add09b#1.zh: 哈哈！把你们身上所有的东西都留下来，顺便把那两个妞也留下！
N-add09b#1.t: Haha! Leave everything you've got, and leave those two girls while you're at it!

N-add09b#3.zh: 可恶！你们谁敢碰这两个女人，我林冲一定把你们打得满地找牙！
N-add09b#3.t: Damn you! Lay a finger on these two women and I, Lin Chong, will knock your teeth all over the ground!

N-add09b#5.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add09b#7.zh: 失败条件二 --- 林夫人或锦儿被抓
N-add09b#7.t: Defeat 2 --- Lady Lin or Jin'er is captured

N-add09b#8.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add09b#9.zh: %N死亡，林夫人被盗贼所擒，不知所踪，林冲闻讯，失去求生意志，横刀自尽，众人眼见再也无力回天，一一接受朝廷招降........
N-add09b#9.t: %N died, and Lady Lin was carried off by the bandits, never to be found. When Lin Chong heard, he lost the will to live and took his own life. Seeing all was lost, the others one by one accepted the court's amnesty........

N-add09b#10.zh: 林夫人被擒，为保全名节，咬舌自尽，%N无颜再见林冲，杀出重围后，隐居江湖........
N-add09b#10.t: Lady Lin was captured and bit off her tongue to keep her honour. Too ashamed to face Lin Chong, %N cut his way out and lived in hiding from then on........

N-add09b#11.zh: 锦儿被擒，林夫人与锦儿情同姐妹，一时方寸大乱，终被盗贼所擒，%N杀出重围，报与林冲，林冲受此打击，心智丧失，挥刀攻击%N，%N为求自保，奋力抵抗，与林冲同归于尽........
N-add09b#11.t: Jin'er was captured. Lady Lin, who loved her like a sister, lost her head and was caught too. %N fought his way out and told Lin Chong. The blow drove Lin Chong mad; he turned his blade on %N, who fought back to save himself, and the two died together........
